name: Believers
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are those who are spiritually born again, as Jesus teaches the necessity of being born of water and the Spirit to enter God's kingdom (John 3:5). From the womb, God has a sovereign plan for His people, calling them by name and forming them intentionally (Psalms 139:13; Isaiah 49:1). Believers will face opposition and hatred for Christ's sake but are called to endure faithfully until salvation is complete (Matthew 10:22). Their faith is marked by divine empowerment, including signs such as casting out devils and speaking in new tongues, demonstrating the transformative power of belief in Christ (Mark 16:17).
